thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPENED: GPU_PREFILL_OOM - multiple container restarts observed in us-west-2 prefill pool. Pager triggered.

alice_sre: Seeing repeated OOMs on prefill for long-context requests, container restart loop on node gpu-pool-17.

alice_sre: First signs ~3332221105, ramping at 3332221150. Not widespread across all nodes but concentrated.

bob_runtime: Logs show large sequence length (~150k tokens) attempts during prefill + KV cache growth. Example trace: 
```
E CudaError: out of memory at runtime/kernels.cu:line 432
prefill: alloc_kv_cache(size=75GB) -> OOM
container: process exited with signal SIGKILL
```

dave_infra: Can isolate node gpu-pool-17 and cordon to stop new allocations. Running drain now.

dave_infra: Command: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-pool-17 && kubectl drain node/gpu-pool-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

alice_sre: Immediate mitigations: 1) apply prefill token cap at router for this pool, 2) enable fallback to quantized-coldmodel for long prompts, 3) trim KV cache aggressively.

bob_runtime: I'll push a throttle rule to edge: `prefill_max_tokens=8192` for requests routing to us-west-2-prefill. Also enable `kv_trim_ratio=0.6` for the runtime.

carol_custops: Customer-reported impact: two enterprise customers experienced streaming disconnects and increased 5xxs between 3332221160-3332221240. CS notified and escalating.

alice_sre: Status update: throttle pushed at 3332221202. Observed drop in new restarts within 30s, still 2-3 flapping containers during eviction window.

bob_runtime: Rolling restart of affected pods with trimmed caches in progress. Patch applied to runtime to avoid prefill allocating full KV on preflight checks (hotfix v1.4.3).

dave_infra: Node isolated successfully, shifting heavy sessions to dedicated pool d-pool-02. Migration commands executed.

alice_sre: Customer impact: transient errors only, no data loss. CS will follow up with timeline and mitigation notes.

alice_sre: Handing off to next on-call @erin_pager for overnight monitoring and any followups. Key todo for handoff: monitor container restart rate <1/hr, confirm KV trimming holding, verify fallback model usage rates.

erin_pager: taking handoff. I'll keep watches on logs/alerts and update the incident channel if anything resurfaces. :white_check_mark: 

alice_sre: Thanks team. Will update post-incident writeup with root cause analysis and recommended autoshed thresholds. :memo:
